newsitem.title: GERMANY: German aluminium body neutral on EU import tariffs.
newsitem.headline: German aluminium body neutral on EU import tariffs.

text.p: German aluminium industry association GDA sought to stay out of discussions about a six percent tariff on aluminium imports in Europe, GDA general secretary Christian Wellner said on Tuesday.

Middle Eastern producers, namely Dubai Aluminium Co Ltd (Dubal), and European fabricators interested in link-ups are challenging the tariff, which they say distorts trade and penalises EU manufacturers.
"We cannot put forward our position because we represent both primary producers and processing interests," Wellner told Reuters after a news conference.
"But we are surprised the discussion has come up as early as now, given the next GATT round is some way off."

Bernard Legrand, chairman of the European Aluminiumn Association and head of Pechiney's aluminium division, 2 said last week the tariff would be kept for the time being, as it offset dollar fluctuations and the effect of cheap imports.
Wellner said if the row intensified, GDA would ask primary producers to represent their interests independently, as in the question of voluntary production cuts.

GDA represents 102 companies in the primary and secondary production of aluminium as well as processors who jointly represent one third of EU aluminium output. -Vera Eckert, Duesseldorf newsroom, +49-211-3882-243
